email.body1:
Michael, saw Topia launched Horizon, its agentic AI platform for global mobility.

A launch like that throws off more inbound and intent signals than the team can act on quickly, and the lag between a signal firing and a rep touching it is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously the moment a signal lands, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Topia off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for Topia.

Most RevOps teams know the data is messy and the follow-up is slow, but can't quantify what it costs in missed meetings. Our built-in best practices alone tend to lift response rates 50 to 70%, and every send auto-logs to the CRM clean.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and the measurable lift you'd expect at Topia.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for Topia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Topia's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action and outbound efficiency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A launch cycle is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I'll tailor it to Topia either way.
